title: GET /api/runs/:id/events serves the whole feed on every poll with no cursor support
body: A follower of a long cloud run re-reads the full standing feed every interval (cloud logs' tail bound has no feed equivalent). It is bounded today by run structure (one segment per dispatch/collect/terminal event), but a gate run with many waves grows the read without bound, and a 1MB response cap would eventually truncate it silently. A Range/offset parameter or segment-since cursor would keep reads bounded; the Go side already speaks byte cursors and needs no change.
